claim: Bounded isolated-harness diagnostics correlate original pg.Client.query ordinals to internal ALS origin, exact HTTP method, logical action, closed route/scope and safe SQL structure fingerprint. This patch is not a query-budget fix.

preservedFailure.warning: Neither this local fixture GREEN nor earlier CI evidence replaces the original full-window failure or proves current-candidate Native acceptance.

invariants: Product registers metadata-only ALS readers; no subscribers are invoked and no per-query work occurs without the isolated harness.
The diagnostic reader registry preserves module copies; unavailable, invalid, missing and multiple active readers are explicitly unknown.
No additional pg wrapper is introduced. Existing manageDatabasePool AsyncLocalStorage.bind owns queued callback restoration.
Only self-generated internal HTTP/logical UUIDs are joined. External requestId, cookies, headers, arguments and raw user identifiers are excluded.
Every retained query uses its original queryCalls ordinal at the unchanged Client.query hook; the 17 operation and 78 source counters are preserved.
Window membership is (before.queryCalls, after.queryCalls], independent of request start or completion timestamps. Inherited after/background work remains counted.
A captured null action stays null; a later physical completion never assigns pre-authentication SQL to a logical child.
Unknown context, unknown structure, unmatched or unpaired receipts and cap overflow are visible independently; missing or dropped evidence is never a synthetic zero.
All four windows and twelve checkpoints are unchanged. Normal metrics snapshots keep the existing fields and 8192-byte bound.
One bounded diagnostics export occurs after existing measurements and cleanup via rpcActions; it is frozen at the first export until an explicit existing reset.
Existing physical/logical RPC aggregates are unchanged; historical aggregate-only reports cannot retroactively acquire query-level diagnostics.
SQL text and parameter values are never retained or exported; normalizedStructureId hashes only the conservative normalized structure, not production raw statementId.

riskCategories.boundary: ALS IDs establish origin correlation only. Equal normalized structures do not prove equal parameters or redundant work. A carried request may execute after its HTTP completion.
Multiple active modules, foreign registry and overflow remain unknown. Fixture tests cover actual queue restoration and client reuse; compiled Native still needs current-source verification.

Fingerprints have a distinct normalizedStructureId name. Raw SQL, literals, parameters and user content are absent. Unusual statement syntax remains unknown; conservative command and Proxy boundaries are under final independent review.

No SQL, network or polling is added. The bounded collector adds CPU and memory only in isolated harness processes; no measured production latency or CPU guarantee is claimed. The final export is after measurement and does not enlarge individual snapshots.

This evidence binds the exact six-file isolated candidate. No live PG, compiled Native, current-head CI or production acceptance ran here. Earlier RED remains RED and old CI is not upgraded to validate the candidate.
